recipe.visualDefinition: A central portrait of a male figure in oversized denim and athletic wear, set against a gritty, desaturated urban skyline featuring a prominent architectural arch. The composition is anchored by a large, stylized 1970s-revival logo in the upper left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The warm orange-red of the jersey and logo contrasts against the cool blue of the denim.
The curved silhouette of the architectural arch mimics the rounded forms of the typography.
The gritty, low-fidelity texture of the background emphasizes the crispness of the foreground subject.
The oversized scale of the clothing creates a triangular silhouette that grounds the composition.
coreInvariants: Oversized denim jacket with visible stitching
Desaturated urban background with a large arch structure

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-full shot; subject occupies approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bulbous logo in the top-left corner acts as the primary weight against the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-left logo, moves down to the subject's face, follows the denim jacket lines to the belt, and arcs back up via the background arch.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with urban detail and large-scale graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Indigo blue (denim) and muted concrete grey (background).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Burnt orange and terracotta red (jersey, hat, and logo).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white (headband, undershirt, and logo outline).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground subject and logo; low saturation and high brightness in the background sky.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy reds and industrial blues

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal counters
Double-stroke outlining (white inner, dark brown outer)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capital letter features an exaggerated, circular swash that cradles subsequent letters
Descending tails are curled into tight, bulbous spirals

composition.overlap: Overlays the background and slightly touches the subject's hat

treatment.outline: Thick white border followed by a thin dark drop-shadow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the fluid, organic logo with rigid, blocky athletic numbering on the clothing.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s-revival weight and rounded nature
Matches the liquid, psychedelic flow of the strokes

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Photograph a subject in baggy 2000s streetwear (denim jacket, jersey) in front of a city skyline with a large arch. Desaturate the background and apply a slight film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom vector lettering in the top-left corner using a thick white stroke and a burnt-orange fill. Ensure the lettering has a heavy, rounded, liquid appearance.

verificationChecks: Is the logo in the top-left corner?
Does the denim have visible, high-contrast stitching?
Is the background arch clearly visible but desaturated?
Does the typography use a double-outline effect?

adjustableVariables: Color of the jersey (must remain warm-toned)
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
Specific text content of the main logo
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the subject's pose is relaxed and centered.
Check that the orange in the logo matches the orange in the clothing.
Verify the background arch is centered behind the subject.
Confirm the denim texture is coarse and visible.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central streetwear portrait + desaturated urban arch background + top-left bulbous psychedelic logo = Early 2000s Hip-Hop Aesthetic.
